fehler.kontorolle: System account and package are roles for accounts that aren’t people – they can’t be given to users.
systemkonten.beschreibung: Accounts under which Ablago itself and packages with code work. They never sign in, have no password and no API key, and don’t appear in any selection. What they may do with folders you set in the rules on the folder type with the roles “System account” and “Package”.
systemkonten.paketEntfernt: Package removed – the account stays for the history.
systemkonten.rechte: Permissions on folders: rules with the role “{rolle}”
verwaltung.hinweis: Something is waiting for the administration.
systemkonten.fehler.angehalten.text: At least one automation of this account is paused. Workbench → Automations shows why.
systemkonten.weitreichend.text: This package may change all folder types or read all of them and access the network as well. Check on the package whether that’s what you want.
verwaltung.fehler.letzte: At least one person must keep “Full administration”. First give the permission to another person who can sign in.
verwaltung.fehler.anbieter: You sign in through a provider. Please sign in there again – then it continues without further questions.
verwaltung.fehler.vertretung: While you work on behalf of another person, there is no administration mode.
verwaltung.fehler.bestaetigen: Please sign in again to administer Ablago.
verwaltung.fehler.modus: That’s only possible in administration mode. Choose “Administer Ablago” in the user menu.
verwaltung.fehler.bereich: You may not administer this area of the Workbench.
verwaltung.fehler.frisch: Please sign in again for this action.
verwaltung.fehler.konto: Only someone with “Full administration” can change the account of a person who administers Ablago.
verwaltung.fehler.vergeben: Only someone with “Full administration” can grant administration rights.
verwaltung.fehler.schluessel: API keys never get administration rights. Administration happens only in the interface or with the dms command in the container.
verwaltung.balken.text: You shouldn’t work like this every day. You see all folders, even locked ones.
verwaltung.andere.text: Also in administration mode right now: {namen}
verwaltung.werkbank.text: You reach the Workbench in administration mode – in the user menu under “Administer Ablago”.
verwaltung.werkbank.nicht: The Workbench is for people who may administer Ablago.
verwaltung.werkbank.paket: Packages are installed by whoever administers Ablago. Send the link to that person.
verwaltung.dialog.text: Please sign in again. Afterwards you are in administration mode until you end it or do nothing for 15 minutes.
verwaltung.dialog.abgelaufen.text: After 15 minutes without activity, administration mode has ended. Sign in again and it continues – what you entered is kept.
verwaltung.dialog.wieder.text: Administration mode has expired. You already signed in again today in this browser – one click and you continue administering. What you entered is kept.
verwaltung.dialog.frisch.text: This action is especially sensitive. Confirm it with your password – it then applies for 10 minutes.
verwaltende.wartung.beginn: The start may be at most 24 hours in the future – from the announcement on, only people who may administer Ablago can sign in.
verwaltende.ansicht.text: “For everyone” applies to every person who administers – they only see their own areas. “Only for me” additionally shows an area just for you.
verwaltende.berechtigungen.modus: In administration mode you see everything – permissions don’t apply then.
verwaltende.postfach.andere: Another person who administers Ablago started this sign-in.
verwaltende.anmeldeschutz.mail: Email to everyone who manages sign-in protection
verwaltende.zweifaktor.pflicht: Require for everyone who may administer
verwaltende.oidc.gruppe.leer: empty: grant administration rights only in Ablago
verwaltende.vertretung_one: Someone who administers Ablago worked on your behalf
verwaltende.vertretung_other: People who administer Ablago worked on your behalf
verwaltende.wartung.neu: New sign-ins are only possible for people who may administer Ablago.
verwaltende.vertretung.chip: someone is working on your behalf
verwaltende.oidc.lokal: Password sign-in only for people who may administer
notfall.fehler.konto: This account can’t be chosen here. Only active people who may administer Ablago can be chosen.
notfall.fehler.heimnetz: Emergency access only works from the home network. Open this page on a device in the same network as Ablago, for example on the Wi-Fi at home.
notfall.fehler.warten: Please wait {sekunden} seconds, then you can enter it again.
notfall.fehler.benutzt: This emergency code has just been used – it works only once. Sign in with the new password or use the RESCUE file.
notfall.fehler.blatt: This link to the emergency sheet is no longer valid. Sign in and download the emergency sheet under Workbench → Encryption.
notfall.fehler.aus: There is no emergency access here.
notfall.seite.fehler: That didn’t work. Please try again.
notfall.seite.verbindung: Ablago can’t be reached right now. Check the connection and try again.
notfall.seite.heimnetz.rat: If you are on your home Wi-Fi and still see this message, open Ablago via its address in the home network, for example the NAS’s IP address. If that doesn’t help, there is still the route via the RESCUE file (administrator manual → Emergency).
notfall.seite.einleitung: Locked out? With the emergency code from your emergency sheet you can get back in. It is in the box “Locked out?” at the bottom of the sheet.
notfall.seite.code.hinweis: {anzahl} characters in groups of four. Upper and lower case, spaces and hyphens don’t count.
notfall.seite.schluessel: Don’t enter the key from the emergency sheet – it never belongs in the browser. After each wrong entry, input is locked for {sekunden} seconds.
notfall.seite.konto: The emergency code is correct. For which account are you setting a new password?
notfall.seite.keine: There is no active account that may administer Ablago. Then only the route via the RESCUE file helps (administrator manual → Emergency).
notfall.seite.folgen: All sign-ins of this account will be ended and two-factor sign-in reset – you set it up again if needed. Everyone who administers Ablago gets an email. The emergency code is then no longer valid.
notfall.seite.gesetzt: New password set. You sign in with {email}.
notfall.seite.blatt: The old emergency code is no longer valid. Download the new emergency sheet with the new code now, print it and keep it safe – you can destroy the old sheet.
notfall.seite.blatt.geladen: Downloaded. Print it before you continue.
notfall.seite.blatt.pflicht: You can only continue with the new emergency sheet.
